GENERALa) Air India Express Limited  is a company incorporated under the laws of India, having its registered office at Block-4, Vatika One-on-One, Sector 16, NH-8, Gurugram, Haryana-122007, India and is engaged in the business of providing scheduled air transport services within India and abroad, under the brand name ‘Air India Express’  and operating under the IATA designator code ‘IX’. 
b) Applicability: These conditions of carriage (“Conditions of Carriage”) form a binding contract between AIXL (as defined below) and the Passengers (as defined below) in connection with domestic flights and any ancillary products and services provided by AIXL in relation to your travel. Use of our services by a Passenger is subject to the Passenger agreeing to be bound by, and to comply with, these Conditions of Carriage. 
c) Changes to Conditions of Carriage: AIXL may modify or update these Conditions of Carriage at any time without prior notice, except as otherwise required under Applicable Law. By continuing to use our services, you agree to be bound by any updated terms that may apply in the future.
d) Language: These Conditions of Carriage are in English language, and even though there may be translations of these Conditions of Carriage in other languages, English shall be the sole language used in the interpretation of these Conditions of Carriage.
II DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONII. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION
a) In these Conditions of Carriage, the following terms and expressions shall have the meanings set out below:
i. “Adult(s)” shall, for the purpose of these Conditions of Carriage, mean Passenger(s) who have attained the age of at least eighteen (18) years at the time of departure of the flight booked;
ii. “Airport Ticketing Office” or “ATO” means AIXL’s reservation and ticketing office situated at such airport where AIXL carries out its operations;
iii. “AIXL”, “Carrier”, “our”, “us” or “we” means Air India Express Limited, operator of the IX designator code flights;
iv. “AIXL Platform” shall include (a) AIXL mobile application; (b) the Website, and (c) Tia (chatbot of AIXL), through which we offer our services, including enabling Passenger(s) to make and manage online Bookings, check-in, check their flight status, purchase ancillary and third-party services, access policies, etc.; 
v. “Applicable Law” shall mean to the extent it applies to a person, all applicable:
A. statutes, enactments, acts of legislature or parliament, laws, ordinances, rules, by-laws, regulations, listing agreements, notifications, guidelines, instructions or policies issued by any governmental authority.
B. administrative interpretation, writ, injunction, directions, directives, judgment, arbitral award, decree, orders, or governmental approvals of, or agreements with, any governmental authority.
in each case, as may be in force from time to time in the jurisdictions that are relevant to such person, concerned flights and shall include the Civil Aviation Requirements;
vi. “Baggage” or “baggage” means the bags, luggage, and suitcases containing your personal property, and carried along with you in connection with your trip and are accepted by the Carrier for carriage. Unless otherwise specified, it includes both your Checked Baggage and Cabin Baggage;
vii. “Baggage Allowance” means the amount of Checked Baggage and/or Cabin Baggage that a Passenger may carry for travel on our flights; 
viii. “Baggage Identification Tag” means a document issued by AIXL solely for identification of Checked Baggage and is attached to such Checked Baggage;
ix. “Boarding Pass” means the physical or digital document issued by AIXL to a Passenger as evidence that the Passenger has checked in for a flight; 
x. “Booking” means a confirmed booking made by any person through an authorised reservation channel for a Seat, and includes the creation of an Itinerary; 
xi. “Booking Number” or “PNR” means a passenger name record, which is a unique booking reference number given by us to identify the relevant Booking in our database/records for a sector or combination of sectors; 
xii. “Cabin Baggage” or “Hand Baggage” means any Baggage other than Checked Baggage which the Passenger is permitted to carry with him/her in the flight, including all items brought into the aircraft cabin in accordance with these Conditions of Carriage and Applicable Laws;
xiii. "Checked-in Baggage" or “Checked Baggage” means baggage which is carried by AIXL for the Passenger and for which AIXL has issued a Baggage Identification Tag. Checked Baggage cannot be carried as Cabin Baggage by the Passenger(s); 
xiv. “Child” or “Children” shall, for the purpose of these Conditions of Carriage, mean a person who has reached his/her second birthday but not his/her 12th birthday at the time of departure of flight.
xv. “Civil Aviation Requirements or CARs)” means Civil Aviation Requirements issued by the DGCA under Rule 133A of the Aircraft Rules, 1937, as amended and includes any successor requirements/ regulations. Reference to such Civil Aviation Requirements shall mean the most recent version with all the relevant amendments; 
xvi. “Connecting Flight” means a subsequent flight providing onward travel on the same Itinerary or on a single Booking Number which meets our Connecting Time; 
xvii. “Connecting Time” means a time between the arrival of one flight to the departure of another flight for Connecting Flights which shall not be less than fifty (50) minutes and not more than twelve (12) hours apart, which is subject to change due to airport restrictions, operational requirements and/or Force Majeure event; 
xviii. “Convenience Fee” means a non- refundable fee applicable per Passenger per flight per segment for payment transactions collected by AIXL when booking is done through AIXL Platform, for establishing, maintaining and operating the online flight booking system.  
xix. “Damage” includes death, injury, delay, loss, partial loss, costs, expenses, or other damage of whatsoever nature arising in the course of carriage or other services performed by us;
xx. "DGCA" means Directorate General of Civil Aviation, Government of India;
xxi. “Domestic Flight(s)” means a flight for which the place of departure and the place of destination are both situated in India;
xxii. “Fare” means the published fare for the flight, as on the date of Booking, which may be any of the following- regular fare, premium fare, corporate fare and any other fare which we offer on a regular basis or promotional basis; 
xxiii. “Fare Rules” mean the specific conditions/restrictions attached to a particular Fare type offered by AIXL.
xxiv. "Force Majeure" means the occurrence of unusual or unforeseeable circumstances that are beyond AIXL’s control, the consequences of which could not have been avoided even if all due care had been exercised by AIXL  to prevent such occurrence i.e. extraordinary circumstances beyond the control of AIXL, including without limitation political instability, natural disaster and other acts of God and nature, pandemics, lockdowns, wars, insurrection, riots, floods, explosion, government regulation, order or requirements affecting the aircraft, strikes, labour disputes, slow down or interruption of work, cancellation and delays clearly attributed to air traffic control, metrological conditions, acts of terrorism, security risks, hostilities, disturbances, shortage of critical manpower, parts or materials, mechanical, technical, or operational issues or failures, or any other factors that are beyond the control of AIXL, which affects its ability to operate flights on schedule;
xxv. “Indemnity Form” means the indemnity form signed by the Passenger or the parents of the Passenger, or legal guardians of the Passenger and submitted with AIXL for the situations detailed in this Conditions of Carriage;
xxvi. “Infant” means a Passenger below the age of two (2) years at the time of departure for each flight;
xxvii. “Itinerary” means the booking confirmation document issued to Passenger(s) in relation to an AIXL flight that includes Passenger’s name, Route, flight number, Booking Number and relevant notices and conditions;  
xxviii. “INR” shall mean Indian Rupee.
xxix. "Minor” means, for the purpose of these Conditions of Carriage, Passenger(s) aged five plus (5+) years to twelve (12) years at the time of departure for each flight; 
xxx. "No-Fly List" means the database of unruly passengers as maintained by the Carrier and/or DGCA;
xxxi. “Passenger”, “you”, “your”, or “yourself” means any person, except members of the crew, carried or to be carried in an aircraft pursuant to a Booking;
xxxii. “Products and Services” means certain add-on products and services offered by AIXL to its Passengers on a chargeable basis, click here to know;
xxxiii. “Products and Services Fee” means published fee, either electronically and/or on paper, offered by AIXL to its Passengers for Products and Services available on AIXL Platform. Such Products and Service Fee are subject to change from time to time, click here to know. 
xxxiv. “Route” means the flight from the airport at the point of origin to the airport at the point of destination (final destination in case of a Connecting Flight);
xxxv. “Seat” means a seat in our aircraft for a particular AIXL flight;
xxxvi. “TFC” shall have the meaning as ascribed to the term in Article IV(b);
xxxvii. “Terms of Contract” means those statements contained in or delivered with the Itinerary, which incorporate by reference these Conditions of Carriage and notices or travel requirements available at AIXL’s offices and check-in counters, ticketing counters, boarding gates and/or on the AIXL Platform; 
xxxviii. “Ticket” or “Electronic Ticket” includes the Itinerary, or any other document issued by us or on our behalf, which evidences a confirmed Booking in our records/database; 
xxxix. “Ticket Price” shall collectively mean the Fare, and Products and Services Fee (wherever applicable);
xl. "Trade Partner" means a travel agency/travel portal that makes Bookings, issues Tickets and provides other ancillary services for our flights and accepts consideration for the same from Passengers. For the avoidance of doubt, Trade Partner is an independent entity facilitating Bookings and is not a representative of AIXL;
xli. “Unaccompanied Minor” or “UM” means a Minor travelling without an accompanying Adult, but as per the process laid down in Clause IX (c) of these Conditions of Carriage;
xlii. “Young Passenger(s)” shall, for the purpose of these Conditions of Carriage, mean Passenger(s) aged between twelve (12+) years to eighteen (18) years at the time of departure for each flight; and
xliii. “Website” means the website of AIXL, which is www.airindiaexpress.com  or such other website as provided by us for the purpose of, inter-alia, making online Bookings, providing ancillary services, etc.
b) Interpretation:
(i). Overriding Effect: In the event of any inconsistency/conflict between the provisions of these Conditions of Carriage and any other applicable policies or terms and conditions for any specific service, offer, etc. of AIXL (“Other Terms”), the provisions of the Other Terms shall prevail, unless otherwise stated in the Other Terms. 
(ii). Headings: The titles or headings of each Article of these Conditions of Carriage are inserted solely for reference and are not intended as complete or accurate descriptions of content thereof and are not to be used for interpretation of these Conditions of Carriage. “Article” means the articles of these Conditions of Carriage. 
(iii). The use of words in the singular or plural, or with a particular gender, shall not limit the scope or exclude the application of any provision of these Conditions of Carriage to any person(s) to whom it may be applicable in the circumstances, except as the context otherwise permits.
III TRAVEL; FLIGHT ITINERARY/TICKET (a). Principal Evidence of Contract: The Ticket/Itinerary constitutes the primary evidence of the contract of carriage between a Passenger and AIXL. All Passengers traveling/making Bookings with AIXL (through any authorized reservation channels, including, ATO, AIXL Platform or Trade Partners) shall be bound by the Conditions of Carriage. We will provide carriage only to the Passenger(s) named in the Ticket/Itinerary. The Ticket/Itinerary/Booking shall at all times remain AIXL’s property. The Terms of Contract contained in the Ticket is a brief summary of some of the provisions of the Conditions of Carriage, including our policy on refunds, Fares, Baggage, etc., and Passengers shall always refer to these Conditions of Carriage at the time of Booking. 
(b). Validity and Non-Transferability: The Itinerary/Ticket is only valid for the Passenger(s) named and for the flight specified therein. The Itinerary/Ticket is non-transferable to any other person. 
(c). Identification: You will be required to produce appropriate and valid photo identification proof in original (including government-issued photo identification document such as driving license, election photo identification card, passport, AADHAR card, etc.) at the time of travel (including at the check-in counters), or any other document(s) as required under the Applicable Law and/or AIXL policies. For Infants without any government-issued photo identification, valid birth certificates need to be produced at the time of check-in for age proof. AIXL disclaims any liability owing to mismatch in the Ticket vis-à-vis the identification proofs of the Passengers.
IV FARES(a). General: Fare apply only for carriage from the airport at the point of origin to the airport at the point of destination, unless expressly stated. Fare excludes surface/ground transport between: (i) two airports, (ii) airports and town terminals, or (iii) anywhere else, unless otherwise specifically stated by us.  AIXL offers Fare on one-way and round-trip basis for ease of purchase. It is clarified that AIXL does not issue open Bookings, i.e., a Booking is required to have a specific date, sector, time of travel, Passenger name(s), etc. and cannot be booked in an open-ended manner. A Convenience Fee will also be levied per transaction on all modes of payment (as detailed below) for Tickets booked through AIXL Platform. The Ticket Price must be paid in full prior to the scheduled time of departure.  Any change in Itinerary or dates of travel may lead to change in the Ticket Price to be paid. In such an event, you may be required to make extra payment in accordance with the Fare Rules. 
AIXL shall not be liable to a Passenger for any missed connecting flights (including any rescheduling/cancellation of travel/hotel arrangement, or any other damages incurred by the Passenger) on a separate ticket/booking (regardless of whether it is AIXL’s flight or any other flight) other than our Connecting Flight (except where the failure to meet a connecting flight is due to any act or omission of the Passenger, in which case, AIXL shall not be liable). If you have purchased a Connecting Flight, you shall fly according to the sequence provided in your Itinerary from the point of origin to the final destination via any transit point as determined by us. If you have purchased a Connecting Flight involving more than one participating airline, you shall be subject to the terms and conditions of carriage of each respective airline through which you fly. 
(b). TFC: TFC shall mean any taxes, fees and any other charges which shall form part of our Fares as published and is calculated as on the date of the Booking. For the purpose of this Conditions of Carriage, “taxes” shall mean any amount payable to the Government; and “fees” shall mean the amount payable to a service provider for the provision of any service or facility to the Passengers. All payments including the Fare must be paid in full prior to the scheduled time of departure. However, if there are any changes to the existing TFCs, or if a new TFC is imposed by the Government, airport authorities or AIXL (on account of any extraordinary circumstances), etc., after the date of issuance of Ticket, AIXL reserves the right to collect the same from the Passenger at the time of Check-in or boarding.  
For detailed TFC please refer to the tariff sheet. 
(c). Non-Receipt of Payment: Fare along with the TFC shall be paid in full when a Booking is made and shall have been successfully received by AIXL. In the event, where AIXL’s booking system does not acknowledge the receipt of payment on account of any technical error or on non-receipt of payment from the bank or any default of payment for any reason whatsoever, we reserve the right to cancel the Booking prior to check-in and/or deny boarding. Further, Passenger(s) acknowledge and agree that AIXL shall not be responsible for the carriage of the said Passenger(s) under the said Booking, or for any liability whether, consequential, direct, or indirect liability or losses thereof.  
(d). Mode of payment: AIXL accepts the following modes of payment for Tickets purchased directly from AIXL: (i) cash; (ii) credit cards (VISA, Master Card, RuPay, etc.); (iii) debit cards; (iv) net banking; (v) payment wallets; (vi) payments through united payments interface; (vii) credit shell/vouchers; (viii) and prepaid instruments such as gift cards; and (ix) loyalty points (if applicable); or any other form of payment as added from time to time. AIXL, however, does not guarantee availability of any specific mode at the time of Booking. 
(e). Discounts: Indian armed forces personnel, senior citizens, student and other special categories of persons as may be prescribed from time to time on AIXL Platform may be eligible for special discounts or benefits. At the time of Booking and check-in, such persons shall be required to provide appropriate government issued identification proof and/or a valid document in support to claim such discounts or benefits. 
(f). Self-Offloading Fee: In general, self-offloading after boarding an aircraft is not permitted, since it can cause safety and security risks besides inconveniencing other Passenger(s) on-board and delay departure. If any Passenger expresses desire to off-load himself/herself and is subsequently off-loaded (in sole discretion of AIXL), then such Passenger shall be charged a self-offloading fee as decided by AIXL. In such a case, the Ticket Price paid by the Passenger for such Booking shall stand forfeited and not be refunded to the Passenger. AIXL may, at its sole discretion, not charge the self-offloading fees, in case of a medical emergency and other personal emergencies subject to submission of appropriate supporting documents as requested by AIXL. In case of self-offloading by a Passenger due to a medical emergency, AIXL may require a medical certificate in relation to the same from the airport doctor as well. 
(g). Currency: We determine, fix and publish Fare and Products and Service Fee only in INR, unless otherwise specifically stated by AIXL. For the convenience of the Passengers, Ticket Price may also be payable in the currency chosen by a Passenger or a travel agent while making a Booking. A Passenger or a travel agent can choose only from the options of currencies provided by AIXL, on AIXL Platform. Please note that the amount of Fare and Products and Service Fee in some currencies (other than INR) are fixed by AIXL and may not be equivalent to the amount obtained after converting such amounts in INR at the exchange rate applicable at the time of Booking.
(h). Fare, TFC, Products and Service Fee are subject to change from time to time without prior notice. Passengers shall always refer and be bound by these Conditions of Carriage at all times. Tickets booked through AIXL Platform or through other authorised reservation channels offering sale of AIXL flight Tickets, are subject to these Conditions of Carriage, however, our promotional Fare may be subject to certain additional terms and conditions. 
V BOOKING OF SEATS (a). Confirmation of Booking: The Booking is confirmed after full payment of Ticket Price is made and upon issuance of an Itinerary. The Bookings can be made by the Passengers through authorised reservation channels, including AIXL Platform, ATO and Trade Partners. Further, Passengers can make Bookings until two (2) hours prior to the scheduled departure of any flight.
(b). Group Bookings:
(i). General: Group Booking is allowed for a minimum of ten (10) Passengers travelling in a group on the same date, same flight and same sector. Fares and Seats are strictly subject to availability and are on a first come first serve basis only. Groups with size up to thirty (30) Passengers, should report at least ninety (90) minutes prior to departure, and with size above thirty (30) Passengers should report at least one hundred twenty (120) minutes prior to departure to allow for smoother processing, unless any longer reporting time is advised by AIXL at the time of Booking or post-Booking. Round trip Bookings cannot be split into two one-way Bookings. Seat allocation may be done while making the group Booking. All passengers will be required to mandatorily web check-in and fill in the self-declaration form prior to arriving at the airport. For any further detail in relation to group Booking (including cancellation, payment structure, name change etc.), please contact us  through email at in_groupdesk@airindiaexpress.com.
(c). Date Change: Once a Booking Number has been issued, date change may be made by Passengers until two (2) hours prior to the scheduled time of departure of a flight, after which, in accordance with Applicable Law, no such changes shall be allowed. In the event of such date change, a flight change fee and Fare difference (where applicable) shall apply, subject to the following conditions: 
(i). if the new flight has a lower Fare (post payment of change fee and fare difference), the remaining Fare difference shall be refunded to the Passenger; 
(ii). if the new flight has a higher Fare, then the Passenger must pay the Fare difference along with the change fee before such flight change can be made; 
(iii). the change is not confirmed until we issue you a new Itinerary and/or Booking Number; and
(iv). changes on Route(s) are not allowed. 
(d). Promotional Fares: Except as provided under applicable CAR, the terms of Article V(c) (Date Change) do not apply to certain promotional Fares, as may expressly set out in any terms and conditions of such Fares. 
(e). Name Correction, amendment, and cancellation of Booking: Once a Booking Number has been issued, Passenger(s) are not allowed to substitute the Passenger(s) named in the confirmed Booking with the name(s) of other Passenger(s). However, in accordance with Applicable Law, we shall not levy any additional charge for correction in the name of the same person when the error is pointed out by the Passenger within twenty-four (24) hours of making the Booking. Further, change in minor details, including gender, date of birth and title of a person is permitted until six (6) hours prior to the scheduled time of departure of a flight. 
(f). Cancellation of Booking by a Passenger: Cancellation of Booking must be made at least two (2) hours prior to the scheduled departure time. AIXL shall levy fee for cancellation as per the Fare Rules as specified in Conditions of Carriage. The aforesaid fee will be deducted from the total amount paid at the time of Booking and, the residual amount, if any, will be refunded to the Passenger(s).
AIXL shall provide a “Look-in option” for a period of forty-eight (48) hours after booking a Ticket. During this period, Passenger(s) can cancel or amend the Ticket without any additional charges, except for the normal prevailing Fare for the revised flight for which the Ticket is sought to be amended. This facility shall not be available for a flight whose departure is less than seven (7) days from the Booking date. 
(g). Seating:
(i). The Passenger shall be allocated a Seat upon check-in. The Passenger may be allotted a Seat randomly or may opt to purchase a Seat of higher value separately through an advance seat request (“ASR”). Subject to availability, the Passenger may pay a fee for an ASR prior to or at the time of check-in. We do not guarantee that we shall provide any particular Seat (whether for an aisle, window, emergency exit row or other type of Seat) on board the aircraft, and the Passenger agrees to accept any Seat that may be allotted or is otherwise made available on the flight. We reserve our right to re-assign Seats at any time, including after boarding the aircraft (and even when an ASR is purchased) for operational, safety, health or security reasons. 
Passengers are allowed to move to Seats of higher value (subject to availability) when on board the aircraft by paying an additional amount. We will, however, make reasonable efforts to honour Seats purchased through ASR, subject to the conditions above. 
(ii). Emergency Exit: The emergency exit seats may be available to Passengers, who, on the date of travel, are:
a) able-bodied; 
b) aged fifteen (15) years and above; 
c) not an expectant mother; 
d) not an Unaccompanied Minor
e) not suffering from a temporary illness which affects their mobility in any way whatsoever; 
f) capable of (1) locating the emergency exit, (2) recognizing the emergency exit opening mechanism, (3) comprehending the instructions for operating the emergency exit, (4) operating the emergency exit, (5) following oral directions and hand signals given by a crew member, (6) stowing or securing the emergency exit door so that it does not impede use of the exit, (7) passing expeditiously through the emergency exit; (8) assessing, selecting and following a safe path away from the emergency exit; 
g) not travelling with an Infant 
h) not otherwise prevented from being seated on emergency exit seat, including for the reasons set out in CAR (Section 8, Series O, Part VIII, Issue I) such as, physical/mental condition preventing the Passenger from opening an emergency exit, etc.
i) any other applicable restrictions that may be imposed from time to time.
AIXL shall have the discretion to assign or re-assign emergency exit Seats and other Seats to Passengers, keeping the prescribed security norms and the safety and comfort of all the Passengers on board a flight in consideration. 
If a Passenger, who has booked an emergency exit Seat in advance, does not meet the safety criteria for being seated on such emergency exit Seat, or if such emergency exit Seat is not available for any reason, Passenger will be assigned a new Seat. In such cases, the excess amount paid by the Passenger for the emergency exit Seat will be refunded.
(h). Denied Boarding: In the event a flight has been overbooked by us due to commercial, operational or technical reasons such as seating capacity optimization, or change in the aircraft from a higher capacity aircraft to a lower capacity aircraft, we will ask for volunteers to give up their Seats so as to make Seats available for the other Passengers. We will accommodate such volunteering Passengers on an alternate available flight, and in addition, may offer certain benefits as deemed fit by us, in accordance with CARs.
If AIXL does not find sufficient number of such volunteers on an overbooked flight, AIXL has the absolute right and discretion to deny boarding to some Passengers based on their check-in sequence at the airport counter (or such other parameters as AIXL may decide from time to time), except certain categories of Passengers, including but not limited to: (a) Children; (b)  expectant mother; (c) Passengers with limited mobility due to injured or fractured limbs or any other disability; (d) Passengers using or requiring wheelchairs, crutches, other prosthetic devices or requiring any special assistance; (e) Passengers with certain adverse medical conditions; and (f) other Passengers accompanying any of the aforementioned persons.
In any event, if a Passenger is denied boarding against his/her will, we shall try our best to arrange an alternate flight which is scheduled to depart within one hour of the original schedule departure time of the initial reservation (in which case, we shall not be liable to pay any compensation). Should AIXL be unable to arrange for an alternate flight departing within one hour from the original scheduled departure time, or where a Passenger booked on a Connecting Flight of AIXL or another airline is delayed at the departure station on account of denied boarding and arrives at the final destination at least three hours later than the scheduled arrival time, a Passenger may claim compensation from AIXL (if it is the first carrier) for the first leg, in accordance with the provisions of the CARs, which is as under: 
a) An amount equal to 200% of booked one-way basic fare plus fuel charge, subject to maximum of INR 10000 in case AIXL arranges alternate flight that is scheduled to depart within the 24 hours of the booked scheduled departure.
b) An amount equal to 400% of booked one-way basic fare plus fuel charge, subject to maximum of INR 20000 in case AIXL arranges alternate flight that is scheduled to depart more than 24 hours of the booked scheduled departure.
c) In case Passenger does not opt for alternate flight, refund of full value of Ticket and compensation equal to 400% of booked one-way basic fare plus fuel charge, subject to maximum of INR 20000.
For the avoidance of doubt, AIXL’s liability for denied boarding will be limited to the extent as specified above 
 Passengers may lodge and claim compensation at help desks placed at arrival and departure stations or through electronic means. If a Passenger is unsatisfied with the resolution provided by us, such Passenger may file their grievances on the Air Sewa application/portal and/or the relevant governmental authorities. 
The following cases will not be considered as denied boarding despite overbooked flights and will not be eligible for any compensation:
(i)         No-Show at check-in and boarding gate by a Passenger;
(ii)       Denial of boarding to any Passenger(s) for reasons set out in Article IX (a).
VI PERSONAL DATA/INFORMATION (a) Passenger is responsible to ensure that during the process of Booking, Passenger’s correct contact details (for example, valid mobile number and e-mail address) are provided to AIXL, either by the Passenger, or the travel agent, or any other person making the Booking on behalf of the Passenger. This will assist AIXL in (i) informing the Passengers of any changes in relation to the flight on which they are booked, (ii) issuing the Itinerary and invoices to the Passengers, and (iii) providing any other relevant information to the Passengers. Carrier shall not be liable to pay any compensation to Passengers, if you miss your flight due to incorrect details.
(b) You hereby acknowledge and agree that your “personal data/information” will be collected and processed by the Carrier in accordance with our Privacy Notice and the Terms of Use, available on our Website.
VII ADD-ONS(a). AIXL may offer (at its sole discretion) certain Products and Services such as Seat selection, pre-paid food and beverages, and pre-paid excess Baggage Allowance to Passengers, which can be availed by Passengers in relation to their travel on AIXL flights. A Passenger may book such Products and Services at the time of making a Booking or thereafter, subject to conditions as may be applicable for such Products and Services including with respect to the timeline for booking/purchasing thereof. Click here to access detailed description of the Products and Services and related terms and conditions.
(b). In-flight products: The provision of in-flight products, services or advertised programmes is subject to availability. In-flight products or services are refundable but non-transferable once purchased. We close bookings or changes to in-flight products or services twenty-four (24) hours prior to the scheduled flight departure time or as otherwise provided on a case-to-case basis. We reserve the right, without prior notice, to amend/change the prices of, or substitute any component for, in-flight products and/or services. The Boarding Pass is proof of purchase of your pre-booked in-flight products or services (including pre-booked meals) and must be presented to the cabin crew on board to avail such pre-booked in-flight products or services. 
(c). Meals: Meal selections/choices are subject to change by AIXL from time to time. We close availability and changes to the meal selections twelve (12) hours before the scheduled time of departure, or as otherwise provided on a case-to-case basis. AIXL may provide certain special meals which may be subject to change from time to time, at our discretion. The list of such special meals is available on the Website We recommend that the Passengers pre-book their choice as this increases the possibility of getting the desired meal on the flight. Further, we cannot guarantee, and Passengers will not be entitled to a specific food item or beverage (even if such food item or beverage is pre-booked) if it is unavailable for any reason (and including where the flight is delayed, cancelled, or there are changes to the schedule due to any reason whatsoever), and AIXL shall not be liable and responsible to Passengers for its unavailability.
In case you decide to cancel your Booking in accordance with Article V(f) above, you shall also be entitled to refund towards the meal booked by you.
We reserve the right, without prior notice, to amend/change the prices for pre-booked meals and substitute any component of the pre-booked meal with an item of similar value subject to availability and/or aircraft suitability. All prices and/or savings quoted from your pre-booked meals and other in-flight products (as the case may be) are valid at the time of Booking. 
AIXL does not provide a nut-free environment, and meals and snacks purchased on board, along with food carried on-board by other Passengers may contain nuts. Please also note that any of the following food items which may be provided on-board may contain certain allergens including: (i) cereals containing gluten i.e. wheat, rye, barley, oats, spelt or their hybridized strains and products of these; (ii) crustacean and their products; (iii) milk and milk products; (iv) eggs and egg products; (v) fish and fish products; (vi) nuts and their products; (vii) soybeans and their products; and (viii) sulphite in concentrations of 10mg/kg or more. 
As such, we advise Passengers with nut allergies and other allergies to make requisite enquiries and take all necessary medical precautions to prepare for the possibility of exposure on the flight. Should you suffer from any severe allergy, it is important to note that AIXL is unable to provide an allergen-free meal, cabin, or environment on the flights. We recommend that you carry appropriate medication in your Cabin Baggage, pursuant to a prescription obtained from a medical practitioner authorizing use of such medication by the Passenger (if required under the Applicable Law), in the event of a reaction. 
AIXL disclaims all responsibilities and liabilities or Damages that may arise to any Passengers that may have allergic reactions from meals provided by AIXL, and you agree to not hold AIXL liable for any such responsibilities and liabilities or Damages. 
(d). Travel Insurance: As our liability to you is limited as per Applicable Law, in order to mitigate risks, including due to unforeseen circumstances, we recommend that you purchase travel insurance, including to cover the following events: 
(i). Damage, changes in travel plans and travel cancellation;
(ii). loss, delay, or damage to Baggage and/or personal possessions; and/or
(iii). medical costs.
VIII CHECK-IN AND OTHER REQUIREMENTS OF CARRIAGE  (a). Airport Check-In Opening Time: Our check-in counters open two (2) hours prior to the scheduled time of departure. 
(b). Check-In at Airport Counter: Passengers may check-in at the airport counters and collect their Boarding Pass by providing valid photo identification document up to sixty (60) minutes prior to the scheduled departure of the flight. 
(c). Check-In Deadline: Our check-in counters close sixty (60) minutes prior to the scheduled time of departure for Domestic Flights. Check-in deadlines may vary at different airports and for particular flights. It is Passenger’s responsibility to ensure that he/she complies with the check-in deadline. In the event of failure to check-in by the prescribed times for your flight, you shall be considered as “No Show” and will be denied check-in, and the Booking is non-refundable in such events.
(d). Online/Web Check-In:  
(i). Passengers may check-in for the flight on AIXL Platform and they will receive a Boarding Pass on their e-mail address/ WhatsApp contact number made available to AIXL.
(ii). Please note that online check-in will (i) open fourteen (14) days; and (ii) close sixty (60) minutes, prior to scheduled departure time of a flight. 
(iii). Please read the terms and conditions printed on your Boarding Pass carefully.
(iv). It is mandatory to produce a Boarding Pass for security clearance as well as for boarding. A valid photo identification may also be requested at any time at the airport for the purpose of verifying identification of the Passenger.
(e). Online check-in may, at the sole discretion of AIXL, not be available for: 
(i). Passengers with special service requests such as extra Seats, visual and hearing impairment, Unaccompanied Minors, etc.;
(ii). Staff travel, industry discount Tickets, upgrade vouchers, agent discount Tickets, Passengers availing promotional Fares, and other categories of Passengers who are eligible for special discounts (for example students, defence personnel etc.);
(iii). Passengers whose travel is restricted by any governmental authority, or who are identified as having duplicate/matching names or other false identity details; in which case such Passengers may be subject to blocked check-in; and/or
(iv). International credit card verification: Booking made using an international credit/debit card are subject to verification through the Carrier’s risk review tool & if the risk level of the Passenger’s Booking is found to be high, the Passenger may receive a verification call or email from the Carrier in relation to such payment. In certain cases, the Passenger may be required to verify the credit/debit card at the airport check-in or reservation counter and a valid provide photo identification proof with an undertaking and indemnity in favour of the Carrier. Passengers are, therefore, required to carry the following documents at the time of travel (a) Photo identity card, passport or driving license or Aadhaar or PAN; (b) In case of direct Bookings, credit/debit card details such as:
Photocopy of the front and back of the credit/debit card, self-attested by the credit/debit card holder (For security reasons, the credit/debit card holder must strike out the CVV, card expiry date and middle digits of the card number (excluding the first 6 and the last 4 digits) on the photocopy of the credit/debit card, or Credit/debit card transaction statement that verifies the Passenger’s awareness about the credit/debit card transaction In case of Bookings through Travel Partner, information related to Ticket purchase.• Name of the Travel Partner and an auto-generated email from the Travel Partner confirming the travel itinerary. If a payment transaction is not verified in case of direct Bookings, the Ticket will be cancelled, and the original transaction amount will be refunded to the credit/debit card. The Passenger will be required to pay the original Ticket fare again at the airport, failing which the Carrier reserves the right to deny boarding. If a payment transaction is not verified in case of Booking through Travel Partner & further payment by international card for any alternation, the Ticket will be cancelled, and the original transaction amount will be refunded to the travel agency. The Passenger will be required to buy a fresh Ticket directly from the Carrier at the current available Ticket fare, failing which the Carrier reserves the right to deny boarding.
(f). Self-Check-in: We offer self-check-in facilities, which may be subject to specific requirements including that of the concerned airports. 
(g). Boarding:
(i). Boarding Time: The Boarding gates close twenty-five (25) minutes prior to the scheduled time of departure. Failing to arrive by this time and failure to produce relevant documents will lead to a denial of your boarding and shall treated as No-Show. In such events, the Booking is non-refundable except for refund of taxes (if applicable). The Checked-in Baggage of such Passenger(s) will be offloaded and handed over to the Passenger(s) or to the relevant airport authority at the stopover station, without any liability of AIXL.
(ii). Mere check-in or issuance of a Boarding Pass does not guarantee boarding unless the Passenger adheres to all the requirements including the timelines mentioned in relation to boarding in these Conditions of Carriage. The Passenger understands and acknowledges that Boarding related announcements may only be made in the event of a change of the boarding gate or change in the schedule of boarding and may be made orally through the airport sound systems, or through display/ notifications on the digital screens placed at airports by the airport authorities. However, AIXL is under no obligation to make boarding announcements at airports designated as ‘silent airports’ and it is the duty of Passengers to check the flight information display system (operated by an airport operator) for current boarding status and boarding gates. The Passenger understands and acknowledges that AIXL or its staff is not obligated to reach out to the Passenger in the event that the Passenger fails to be present at the boarding gate, in the manner required in terms of these Conditions of Carriage. AIXL is not liable to any Passenger who fails to report at the boarding gate for any reason whatsoever. Any Passenger failing to report at the boarding gate within the aforesaid timelines shall be treated as a No-Show.
(iii). Boarding Process: Boarding will commence at AIXL’s discretion, by zone, and priority may be given to certain Passengers, including Passengers requiring special assistance, members of the loyalty program based on their respective tiers, persons who are travelling with Infants and Children, and other Passengers who may be eligible for priority services.
(h). Compliance: Passengers are solely responsible for complying with all Applicable Laws and requirements of the countries flown from, into or over and with these Conditions of Carriage, Terms of Contract or any other related notices and instructions given by us. We shall not be liable in any manner whatsoever to you in connection with obtaining necessary documents or complying with such Laws, requirements or instructions, whether given orally or in writing or otherwise, or for the consequences to you resulting from your failure to obtain such documents or to comply with such Laws, requirements, or instructions. 
(i). Travel Documents: Passengers are responsible for obtaining and must possess and make available for presentation as required by the relevant authorities, all relevant documents relating to entry, exit, health, etc., required by Applicable Law or requirements of the countries flown from, into or over. We reserve the right to refuse carriage and deny boarding to any Passenger who has not complied with, or whose documents do not appear to comply with, such Applicable Laws or requirements. 
(j). Documents Advisory: Passengers are required to produce their original identity proofs (in the form of government identity cards, or passport), and other relevant travel documents at the time of travel. We may ask the parents, legal guardians of Children, Infants and Minors to produce their original identity proofs (in the form of government identity cards, passport, birth certificate, or adoption certificate) at the time of travel. 
(k). Passenger Responsible for Fines, Medical Costs etc.: If we are required to pay or deposit any fine or penalty or incur any expenditure by reason of your failure to produce the required documents, or for administering any medical care including paramedic services in cases of emergencies at the ports of departure and arrival, you shall on demand reimburse to us any amount so paid or expenditure so incurred or required to be paid. We may apply towards such payment or expenditure the value of any carriage unused by you, or any funds due to you in our possession. 
(l). Security Inspections and Health Checks: A Passenger shall submit to any security inspections by Government and/or airport officials or by AIXL prior to Boarding. If the Passenger refuses to comply with such security inspections, AIXL shall refuse carriage of the Passenger and such Passenger’s Baggage without refund of Fare and without any other liability to the Passenger, unless otherwise provided by Applicable Law or these Conditions of Carriage. Further, a Passenger shall submit to any health checks that may be conducted by Government and/or airport officials. Random physical checks may also be carried out prior to boarding, in addition to above screening, in accordance with the norms stipulated by the authorities. 
IX REFUSAL AND LIMITATION OF CARRIAGE(a). Right to refuse carriage: AIXL may refuse carriage of Passengers or their Checked Baggage or Cabin Baggage and/or remove such Passenger from the flight if, in the exercise of our sole discretion, we determine that: 
(i). such action is necessary for reasons of safety or security; 
(ii). such action is necessary in order to comply with any Applicable Law, regulations, or orders of any State to be flown from, into or over; 
(iii). the conduct, status, mental or physical condition of the Passenger and/or the physical condition of their Checked Baggage or Cabin Baggage is such:
a. as to cause reasonable fear of harm or harassment, to other Passengers or to our crew; or 
b. that the Passenger or the Checked Baggage or Cabin Baggage may pose a hazard or risk to the Passenger, other persons or to any property; 
(iv). the Passenger committed misconduct on a previous flight and there is a reasonable likelihood that such conduct may be repeated; 
(v). the Passenger has not observed, or is likely to fail to observe, our instructions;
(vi). the Passenger refused to submit to a security check; 
(vii). the applicable Ticket Price payable have not been paid; 
(viii). the Passenger does not have the proper documents (including vaccination certificates or ‘negative’ result reports based on RT-PCR testing, if required by state authorities or other regulatory guidelines) for travel. Please note that travel documents that are damaged shall not be accepted as proper documents;
(ix). the Booking or payment thereof has been done fraudulently or unlawfully or has been purchased from a person not authorized by us; 
(x). the debit/credit card used has been reported lost or stolen; 
(xi). the Itinerary or Booking or Electronic Ticket is counterfeit or fraudulently obtained; 
(xii). the Itinerary of the Passenger has been altered by anyone other than us or a Trade Partner, or has been mutilated, in which case we reserve the right to retain such documentation; 
(xiii). that upon check-in or boarding of the Passenger it cannot be proven that the person named as the Passenger in the travel Itinerary is the Passenger who has checked-in or boarded, in which case we also reserve the right to retain such Itinerary;
(xiv). the Passenger has been violent to, or threatened our/other airlines’/airport/security staff or crew or other Passengers or caused disturbance at our counter or has abused such staff or crew whether physically or verbally or in our sole judgment, a Passenger is unfit to travel under the influence of alcohol, drugs, or other substances (for further details in relation to handling of unruly Passengers, please refer to Article XIII); and/or 
(xv). if the Government authority or other relevant authorities prohibits the Passenger from check-in or boarding the aircraft, including addition of such Passenger in any no-fly list.
AIXL, basis the Passenger’s conduct inflight or at the airport, reserves the right to prohibit a Passenger from flying, until such time it may deem fit, in accordance with the Applicable Law

(ii). Carriage of Infants above seven (7) days: Only one Infant (must always be accompanied by an Adult) is allowed with one Adult who may be a parent, guardian, relative or friend who acts as an escort, subject to the safety and/or operational requirements of the aircraft. Such Adult may be asked to present their identification / proof of relationship to the Infant at the time of check-in or later in the journey. No perambulators are allowed on board the aircraft and are required to be checked in as Checked Baggage. The number of Infants per flight is limited due to safety regulations and as such, there may be a possibility that we may not be able to accommodate your request to carry Infants with you. Infants are entitled to an additional 10 kg of free Checked Baggage allowance that applies to an Adult’s pre booked allowance. Infants are not eligible for any free Cabin Baggage allowance.  
(iii). An Infant is not required by Applicable Law to occupy a passenger Seat. An Infant may travel provided he/she sits on an Adult’s lap. We provide Infant seat belts on request from the Passenger. Proof of age is required, and Passengers are requested to carry the Infant’s valid identification proof for inspection at the airport on date of travel. Infants must hold valid Tickets and must be checked-in and issued a Boarding Pass. 
(c). Travel by Children, Unaccompanied Minors and Young Passengers: 
(i). Children: Children are required to be accompanied by an Adult on the same flight. 
(ii). Unaccompanied Minor: The Unaccompanied Minors are governed by the following conditions:
A. The parent, guardian or any person authorised to act on behalf of the parent/guardian by both the parents of the UM must fill, sign, and submit four copies of the ‘Unaccompanied Minor Travel Form’ at the airport ticketing counter or to the nearest AIXL city booking office at least six (6) hours prior to the scheduled time of departure. The Carrier will refuse travel of the Unaccompanied Minor(s) if the said form is not duly signed and handed over to the Carrier on or before the date of travel. Note: AIXL accepts Unaccompanied Minor only on direct flights and not on Connecting Flights or codeshare flights.   
B. In addition to the Ticket Price of the UM, AIXL shall charge INR 5000 (Rupees Five Thousand Only) (or such fee as may be updated by AIXL from time to time and reflected on the Website) per UM for each leg of the journey of the Domestic Flight.
C. All required information in the UM form must be complete and accurate to facilitate the transfer of the Unaccompanied Minor between designated airports. Parent’s/ Guardian’s/ Ticket purchaser’s failure to provide the necessary details and documents of the UM to the Carrier on or before the scheduled date of departure shall permit the Carrier to refuse the UM service without undertaking any liability for the same.
D. Proof of age in the form of a birth certificate or other form of valid government identification for the UM is required at the ticket counter as well as at the check-in counter at the airport, to travel as an Unaccompanied Minor.
E. A parent or guardian must escort an Unaccompanied Minor to the Carrier’s ticketing counter 120 minutes before scheduled departure and must remain at the airport until the flight is in the air. The parent or guardian receiving an Unaccompanied Minor should be at the arrival gate 45 minutes prior to scheduled arrival. The parent or guardian must produce self-attested ID proof of a valid government-issued photo ID to a Carrier’s representative at the time of departure as well as arrival of the Unaccompanied Minor to facilitate the transfer of the Unaccompanied Minor between the designated airports
F. AIXL will not release an Unaccompanied Minor to anyone other than the designated parent or guardian, the details of which are shared with the Carrier prior to the date of departure. It is the parent's/guardian's responsibility to ensure changes of the designated pick-up parent/guardian are arranged and written consent from them for any such change is received by the Carrier prior to the date of departure.
G. In case the UM has a medical condition, the Unaccompanied Minor assistance service will be provided only after receiving clearance from AIXL’s doctor and if the UM is unwell, the assistance expected should be within the care our staff can provide. AIXL do not extend Unaccompanied Minor assistance service to Minors requiring special assistance.
 
H. Should the Unaccompanied Minor's travel be disrupted or should the person(s) designated fail to meet the Unaccompanied Minor upon arrival at the destination airport, Carrier is fully authorized to take such action as it may consider necessary under the said circumstances. The parent or guardian agrees to reimburse Carrier for any expenses incurred by the Carrier or its staff, representatives, etc. in taking such action.
I. If the stopover at any transfer stations is for more than 6 hours and/or involves a night halt and/or transfer is on another airline, we shall not be able to accept the Minor under the UM services, and such Minor will not be entitled to carriage except where he/she is accompanied by an Adult on the same flight.
J. In the event of a flight delay, diversion, cancellation, or any other irregular operation, AIXL shall ensure that an Unaccompanied Minor, once accepted for carriage, remains at all times under the continuous supervision and care of AIXL or its authorized ground handling agents until such time as the Unaccompanied Minor is safely handed over to the duly designated and authorized guardian. AIXL shall use reasonable endeavours to promptly notify the parent or legal guardian of the Unaccompanied Minor and keep them appropriately informed of the Unaccompanied Minor’s status and any revised travel arrangements. Where operationally feasible and in compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, AIXL may re-accommodate the Unaccompanied Minor on the next available flight, arrange alternate routing, or provide supervised care, including meals, refreshments, and accommodation. In circumstances requiring an overnight stay or extended ground time, AIXL shall make suitable supervised arrangements to safeguard the safety, welfare, and comfort of the Unaccompanied Minor. AIXL reserves the right to determine, in its sole discretion, the most appropriate course of action in the best interests of the Unaccompanied Minor, taking into account safety considerations, regulatory obligations, and operational constraints.
K. Carrier reserves the right not to transport Unaccompanied Minors on flights that are likely to be diverted or cancelled due to weather conditions or other operational disruptions.
L. Unaccompanied Minors are monitored throughout the travel. Once seated, cabin crew will visually observe and/or communicate with an Unaccompanied Minor periodically as and when their duty allows.
M. If on the date of travel, UM crosses the age of 12 years and the person making the Booking still wishes to continue the use of UM service, can avail the same or else can request our support center/airports for removal of UM service and refund of the UM service fee.
N. Carrier does not assume responsibility for an Unaccompanied Minor's actions. THE TICKET PURCHASER/ GUARDIAN AGREES TO INDEMNIFY, HOLD HARMLESS, AND FULLY RELEASE AIXL AGAINST ANY AND ALL INJURY OR DAMAGES TO PROPERTY OR PERSONS CAUSED BY OR INCURRED AS A RESULT OF AN UNACCOMPANIED MINOR'S ACTIONS, INCLUDING INJURIES TO THE UNACCOMPANIED MINOR CAUSED BY HIS OR HER OWN NEGLIGENCE.
O. If these terms and conditions are not met, the Carrier reserves the right to refuse the acceptance of the UM on the Carrier’s flight in its sole discretion and the Carrier shall not be held liable in such a scenario.
(iii). Young Passengers: Young Passengers will be accepted for carriage for traveling alone (without accompanying Adult) only if a parent or guardian signs a ‘Release and Indemnity Form for Acceptance of Young Passengers Travelling Alone (“YPTA”)’ and submits the same either directly or through the Young Passenger at the check-in counter of AIXL. The parent/guardian is required to remain at the airport until the flight has departed, to ensure that the Young Passenger is not left unattended in case of delay or cancellation of the flight. Parents/guardians must ensure that the Young Passengers are carrying a valid photo identification proof, which is mandatory for travel. 
(d). Expectant Mother: It is the duty of an expectant mother to declare to us the stage (true and correct facts) of their pregnancy at the check-in counter or at the boarding gate as the case maybe. The carriage of the expectant mother is subject to the following conditions:
